issues.problem: The new primary source for matrix ticks credits rows to the wrong vendor. A row with an empty or missing vendor (str(None or '') == '') matches 'disp.startswith("")' and is credited to the vendor with the longest display name; prefixes resolve to whichever vendor's display starts with them ('Dev' -> devika, 'S' -> sourcegraph-cody). The docstring says rows without a recognisable vendor are skipped; the schema allows vendor "".
issues.evidence: python3 /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H8b-probe/tools/probe_ticks3.py <scripts> (APO pack, one matrix_entries row {vendor:V, feature:'SSO', supported:true}): '' -> {'barkain-workflow-orchestrator': {'SSO': True}}, ' ' -> barkain-workflow-orchestrator, 'S' -> sourcegraph-cody, 'Dev' -> devika, 'Gi' -> github-copilot-enterprise, 'Cl' -> claude-code-expert.
issues.suggested_fix: In the structured path require an exact (case/space-normalised) match on slug, display name or alias, skip blank vendors, never prefix-match; add minLength:1 to the schema; test blank/null/prefix vendors.
